messages.subject: position_fill bug when in facet_grid
parts:
There seems to be a strange bug when using position_fill inside of facet_grid. I'm setting x to a factor, and fill to another factor with 2 levels. Then I'm using geom_bar(stat = "bin", position = "fill") and faceting by two more variables. When using facet_grid(), the fill factor appears to be at 50% in all facets for all levels of x, but by just changing to facet_wrap(), the plot I was expecting come out.

Here's an example using data from a package I'm working on:

library(ggplot2)
library(devtools)
install_github("SQAwR", username = "JoFrhwld", branch = "master")

library(SQAwR)
dept.sub <- subset(department, r %in% c("del","pron"))

# compare facet_grid to facet_wrap 
ggplot(dept.sub, aes(Store, fill = r)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "bin") + 
  facet_grid(Repetition~Word) ## equal areas

ggplot(dept.sub, aes(Store, fill = r)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "bin") +
  facet_wrap(Repetition~Word) ## the expected plot

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: position_fill bug when in facet_grid
parts:
Hi:

Actually, there's a facet_grid() bug in the release version of 0.9.0
to which this may be related, whose fix should be in the development
version (but see below). One workaround is to do the prep work outside
of ggplot2; then there is no problem whether you use facet_wrap() or
facet_grid() in your example. The code below uses the count() function
from plyr to get the groupwise frequencies followed by the mutate()
function to produce a new column of proportions by r level for each
combination of the other three variables.

library('plyr')
u <- count(dept.sub, c('Store', 'Repetition', 'Word', 'r'))
u1 <- ddply(u, .(Store, Repetition, Word), mutate,
prop = round(freq/sum(freq), 4))
ggplot(u1, aes(x = Store, y = prop, fill = r)) +
geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +
facet_grid(Repetition ~ Word)
ggplot(u1, aes(x = Store, y = prop, fill = r)) +
geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +
facet_wrap(Repetition ~ Word)

Using the development version of ggplot2 in a separate R session, I
came up with blank plots in each case (facet_grid() or facet_wrap())
whether I used your code or mine, so at least in the short term, the
code above is a workaround for the problem in 0.9.0. I'm cc-ing
Winston on this since he's mentioned the facet_grid() bug a few times
before in this group and likely understands the code problem much
better than I.

HTH,
Dennis

messages.subject: Re: position_fill bug when in facet_grid
parts:
Hi Joe:

I just retried your original code with the latest development versions
of ggplot2 and scales installed and it works as you expect for both
facet_grid() and facet_wrap(). To install the development versions, do
the following in a fresh R session:

library('devtools')
dev_mode()
install_github('ggplot2')
install_github('scales')
library('ggplot2')

Now run the code of the two plots from your original post. When I did
so, the plots were the same outside of the strip labeling.

Dennis
